resources.string: Remind only after both the scheduled time and the prior step is Done. Chains reset at midnight.

Remind at the selected time or percentage, but only after this checkpoint is Done. Optional delay starts at completion. Skip and Snooze do not unlock the chain. Chains reset at midnight; both steps must use the same calendar date.
Choose a chain without loops, with a predecessor that repeats on every selected day.
Enter a delay from 0 to 1440 minutes.

Today: reminder missed — you can still complete it
